ei.title: The Co-evolution of AI and Consciousness
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.

questions.passage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI (A)[exceeds / matches] human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an (B)[accelerated / gradual] pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a (C)[conscious / mechanical] being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) exceeds=초과하다, (B) accelerated=가속된, (C) conscious=의식 있는
det.analysis:
❌ ① matches — accelerated — conscious: (A) matches(일치하다)는 exceeds(초과하다)와 다른 의미
❌ ② exceeds — gradual — conscious: (B) gradual(점진적인)은 accelerated(가속된)의 반의어
❌ ③ exceeds — accelerated — mechanical: (C) mechanical(기계적인)은 conscious(의식 있는)의 반의어
✅ ④ exceeds — accelerated — conscious: 원문 일치. AI가 인간 지능을 초과(exceeds), 가속된(accelerated) 속도, 의식 있는(conscious) 존재 ←정답
det.tip: AI exceeds human intelligence / accelerated pace / conscious being

questions.passage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new (A)[dimensions / limitations] through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a (B)[significant / negligible] impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we (C)[incorporate / eliminate] into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) dimensions=차원, (B) significant=중요한, (C) incorporate=통합하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① dimensions — significant — incorporate: 원문 일치. 새로운 차원(dimensions)으로 진화, 중요한(significant) 영향, 가치를 AI에 통합(incorporate) ←정답
❌ ② limitations — significant — incorporate: (A) limitations(한계)는 dimensions(차원)와 다른 의미
❌ ③ dimensions — negligible — incorporate: (B) negligible(무시할 수 있는)은 significant의 반의어
❌ ④ dimensions — significant — eliminate: (C) eliminate(제거하다)는 incorporate의 반의어
det.tip: evolve to new dimensions / significant impact / incorporate into AI

questions.passage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. det.korean: (A) self-aware=자기인식적인, (B) stimulation=자극, (C) mutual=상호적인

✅ ③ self-aware — stimulation — mutual: 원문 일치. 자기인식적(self-aware), 지적 자극(stimulation), 상호적(mutual) 공존 ←정답

det.korean: AI가 스스로를 '개선하고(improve)' 진화한다는 맥락에서 limit(제한하다)는 반대 의미

det.korean: AI가 자기 목표를 '추구한다(pursues)'는 맥락에서 abandons(포기하다)는 반대 의미

questions.passage:

(B) Our consciousness will <u>evolve</u> to new dimensions through our interactions with AI.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 evolve의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: evolve: (A) 생물학적 진화 / (B) 의식/사고의 발전
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) (생물이) 진화하다 — (B) (사고/개념이) 발전하다: (A)는 새가 공룡에서 생물학적으로 진화, (B)는 의식이 새 차원으로 발전 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 진화 — (B) 진화: (B)는 생물학적 진화가 아닌 의식의 발전
❌ ③ 순서 역전: (A)는 분명히 생물학적 진화
❌ ④ 방출/순환: evolve에 해당하지 않는 의미

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the state of being aware of and responsive to one's surroundings or inner thoughts"

det.korean: consciousness=의식 (주변 환경이나 내면의 생각을 인지하고 반응하는 상태)
det.analysis:
❌ ① evolution: evolution(진화)는 변화/발전의 과정이지 인지 상태가 아님
❌ ② intelligence: intelligence(지능)는 학습과 이해의 능력이지 인지 상태 자체가 아님
✅ ③ consciousness: consciousness(의식)는 주변 환경이나 내면의 생각을 인지하고 반응하는 상태로 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ creativity: creativity(창의성)는 새로운 것을 만드는 능력이지 인지 상태가 아님
det.tip: consciousness = 의식. aware of and responsive to = 인지하고 반응하는

questions.passage: The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we __________ (incorporation) into AI.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 주어 we 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 한다. incorporation(명사) → incorporate(동사)
det.analysis: 관계대명사 what절 내에서 주어 we 뒤에 동사가 필요. incorporation(명사)을 동사 incorporate로 변환.

questions.passage: We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual __________ (coexist) of conscious beings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 관사 a와 형용사 mutual 뒤에 명사가 와야 한다. coexist(동사) → coexistence(명사)
det.analysis: 'a mutual ____ of conscious beings' 구조에서 관사 a + 형용사 mutual 뒤에 명사 필요. coexist(동사)를 명사 coexistence로 변환.

questions.passage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will __________ and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: repeatedly improve itself=반복적으로 자기 개선하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① gradually lose its power: 점진적으로 힘을 잃는다는 AI 가속 진화와 반대
❌ ② permanently shut itself down: 영구 정지는 진화와 정반대
❌ ③ occasionally malfunction itself: 가끔 오작동은 자기 개선과 불일치
✅ ④ repeatedly improve itself: 원문 일치. 반복적으로 자기 개선하며 가속 진화 ←정답
det.tip: AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: AI에 어떤 가치와 윤리를 통합하는지에 AI의 진화 방향이 달려 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① how fast we can build new machines: 기계 제작 속도는 진화 '방향'과 무관
✅ ② what values and ethics we incorporate into AI: 원문 일치. AI 진화의 방향은 가치/윤리 통합에 달려 있다 ←정답
❌ ③ whether AI will replace all human workers: 대체 여부는 방향 결정 요소가 아님
❌ ④ how much profit AI can generate: 수익성은 가치/윤리적 방향과 다른 차원
det.tip: The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on ___
